load_images: load images from file paths as grayscale or RGB tensors on CUDA device
get_model: build a SiLK keypoint detection model from a checkpoint with configurable NMS and threshold settings
create_silk_matcher: create a feature matcher with ratio-test postprocessing and configurable threshold
configure_silk_backbone: configure a ParametricVGG backbone with batch normalization and no max pooling
run_silk_detection: run SiLK keypoint detection on images with configurable top-k and border filtering
